title: flare/serve/v1
description: The board a server served and why it stopped.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

stopped.description:
Why the server stopped: `shutdown` after SIGTERM, `interrupted`
after Ctrl-C or `idle` after the idle period.
